usedFor: Eventzilla holds registrations and MSG91 handles tickets in Hello, so “New Registration” can run “Send Mail via Hello”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: A new registration opens a ticket in Hello, so someone follows up with the attendee.

watchOut: “Registration Is Updated” in Eventzilla also reaches “Send Mail via Hello”, so edits could open extra tickets.
